name: Athena Information
description: Athena connects Claude to your Athena Information news-intelligence workspace. Browse the topics your team monitors, search and filter your curated news feed by topic, company, source, country, or date, and run AI-powered analyses with source citations — using your saved analysis presets or ad-hoc questions. At the end of a session, Claude can (with your go-ahead) record which stories were useful to sharpen your feed's future ranking. Access is OAuth-scoped to your organization's tenant: Claude sees only what your Athena account sees, and you can revoke the connection at any time.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Athena Information to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Athena Information to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.athenainformation.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Athena Information MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Athena Information provides these MCP tools: analyse, list_prompts, list_stories, list_topics, and vote_stories.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Athena Information?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Athena Information in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Athena Information MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Athena Information requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Athena Information is developed by Athena Information. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
